title: Generative AI at Work
appraisal: Staggered rollout, primarily fall 2020 and winter 2021; 5,172 agents; adjusted estimate about 15%. One company, heterogeneous effects; not national employment evidence. Identification relies on parallel trends and related event-study assumptions, not verified universal assumptions.

title: We are Changing our Developer Productivity Experiment Design
locator: Opening findings and Wider adoption section, 24 February 2026
appraisal: Early result concerns February–June 2025 tasks; later recruitment, task selection and concurrent-agent time measurement weaken interpretation. No universal current effect claimed.

title: AI Nation 2030 overview
